summary: Iteration 5 testing executed for backend APIs + UI smoke on public URL. Backend suite had 14/16 failures (>50%), so testing stopped per policy. Primary blocker: frontend compile-time syntax error in /app/frontend/app/blog/[slug]/page.js breaks Next build (Unterminated regexp literal), causing widespread 500/502 across public pages and /api routes. Confirmed via pytest failures, browser console, and supervisor logs.

critical.issue: Compile error: Unterminated regexp literal at app/blog/[slug]/page.js line ~30 (missing closing JSX brace in related section), triggers global Next dev rebuild failures and 500/502 responses.
Returned 502 during pytest run due to above compile failure/restart loop.
500 HTML error page showing same module build error trace from blog/[slug] file.

minor.issue: Could not complete reliable validation of service query-link behavior after compile crash; one UI run showed URL not updating after selecting mobile-apps, but route stability was degraded.

ui_bugs.issue: After login attempt, posts/cases/services/projects tabs were not visible in Playwright run because admin page rendering was affected by build/runtime instability.
Blog detail route failed with page error and empty title; console reports SWC compile error from app/blog/[slug]/page.js.

integration_issues.issue: A single syntax error in blog detail component blocks unrelated pages/APIs due Next dev recompilation failure and restart loop.

action_items: Fix JSX syntax in /app/frontend/app/blog/[slug]/page.js related-items block (close conditional expression correctly).
Re-run full backend pytest after fix; current failures are dominated by build crash side effects.
Re-run full admin/UI CRUD flows (Blog/News, Cases, Services, Projects) once app stabilizes.
Re-validate work service filter query-link behavior after build fix.
Re-check test-data cleanup; API cleanup became unreliable once global 500 started.
critical_code_review_comments: app/blog/[slug]/page.js has malformed JSX in the related-links conditional. This is a hard build break, not runtime-only.
Because Next runs in dev with hot reload, this compile fault cascades into repeated restarts/OOM-like behavior and broad endpoint instability.
Given this blocker, test outcomes for business flows after first compile hit are not trustworthy until the file is fixed and app is stable.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (basic homepage/logo/overflow checks passed; admin/blog critical flows blocked)

seed_data_creation: Attempted TEST_CMS5 prefixed content/project/offering/media via API tests. Cleanup could not be fully guaranteed after compile failure started returning 500 HTML on admin CMS APIs.

Until fixed, many routes and APIs intermittently return 500/502. After fix, first rerun should be: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pytech_iter5.py, then Playwright admin/blog/projects/service-work flows.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /blog/<slug> or any route causing app recompilation; console and server logs show SWC error 'Unterminated regexp literal' at app/blog/[slug]/page.js line ~30. Root cause: malformed JSX conditional block for related posts appears to be missing closing brace after mapped div. Impact: Next dev server enters rebuild/restart loop, causing broad 500/502 across unrelated pages and API handlers. Mitigation: correct JSX syntax, verify clean compile, then rerun full regression and cleanup any residual TEST_CMS5 artifacts.
